text-muted.note: Dark theme value; 4.9:1 on #1a1a1a. Light theme uses #757575 (4.61:1 on white).

display.purpose: The largest text in the app: empty-state card headings (15px).

body.purpose: Default UI and control text (12px); form inputs bump to 13px. Field labels, hints, and helper prose also sit at body size.

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-labels at the 11px floor: panel headers, settings section titles, shortcut groups.

mono.purpose: Numeric readouts only: timecode, trim values, speed select.

icon.purpose: Segoe MDL2 Assets glyphs, 10-14px; exempt from the text-size floor.

shadows.name: float-menu
shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus: the only shadow that must beat modals (z-index 2000).

shadows.name: float-modal
shadows.purpose: Modals, the heaviest layer. Float blurs stay under 16px so thin-bordered floats don't read as an AI default.

shadows.name: pressed
shadows.purpose: Active mode-toggle segment and play button inner highlight.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single decisive action per surface (Start Export, Apply).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #00796b; color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00685c; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2ba87e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions next to the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #333333; color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #444444; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2ba87e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Text/number field: sunken graphite-raised fill, accent ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #1a1a1a; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2ba87e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #2ba87e; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #777; }

components.name: Custom Dropdown
components.description: Custom select: native arrow stripped, chevron added, floating menu over everything.
components.css: .ds-dropdown { position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-dropdown-btn { appearance: none; position: relative; display: block; width: 180px; background: #1a1a1a; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 30px 6px 10px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; outline: none; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-dropdown-btn::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 10px; top: 50%; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-right: 1.5px solid #bbb; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #bbb; transform: translateY(-70%) rotate(45deg); } .ds-dropdown-btn:hover { border-color: #444; } .ds-dropdown-btn:focus, .ds-dropdown.open .ds-dropdown-btn { border-color: #2ba87e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #2ba87e; } .ds-dropdown-menu { position: absolute; z-index: 2000; top: calc(100% + 4px); left: 0; min-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: #141414; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); } .ds-dropdown-option { display: block; width: 100%; background: transparent; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 8px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dropdown-option:hover { background: #333; } .ds-dropdown-option.active { color: #2ba87e; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Custom 16px checkbox; checked fills Deep Teal with a popping white check.
components.css: .ds-checkbox { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; color: #fff; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; user-select: none; } .ds-checkbox-input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; } .ds-checkbox-box { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 16px; height: 16px; background: #0a0a0a; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 3px; position: relative; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-checkbox:hover .ds-checkbox-box, .ds-checkbox-input:focus-visible ~ .ds-checkbox-box { border-color: #00796b; } .ds-checkbox-input:checked ~ .ds-checkbox-box { background: #00796b; border-color: #00796b; } .ds-checkbox-box::after { content: ''; position: absolute; display: none; width: 4px; height: 8px; border: solid #fff; border-width: 0 2px 2px 0; transform: rotate(45deg); margin-bottom: 2px; } .ds-checkbox-input:checked ~ .ds-checkbox-box::after { display: block; animation: ds-check-pop 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275); } @keyframes ds-check-pop { 0% { transform: rotate(45deg) scale(0); opacity: 0; } 100% { transform: rotate(45deg) scale(1); opacity: 1; } }

components.name: Mode Toggle
components.description: Segmented Trim/Merge switcher: active segment fills Deep Teal, reads pressed into the track.
components.css: .ds-mode-toggle { display: inline-flex; background: #0d0d0d; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px; } .ds-mode-btn { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; color: #bbb; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-mode-btn:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-mode-btn.active { background: #00796b; color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); }

components.name: Sidebar Panel
components.description: Collapsible settings panel: graphite-panel fill, micro-label header, no shadow.
components.html:
Export Settings

Size target
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #141414; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 4px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 10px; } .ds-panel-header { padding: 0 0 8px 0; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #777; } .ds-panel-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-panel-text { margin: 0; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #ccc; }

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Floating 11px hint with pointer arrow; dark graphite-tooltip fill.
components.css: .ds-tooltip { position: relative; display: inline-block; background: #2a2a2a; border: 1px solid #444; color: #fff; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2px; line-height: 1; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55); } .ds-tooltip::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -5px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg); width: 8px; height: 8px; background: #2a2a2a; border-left: 1px solid #444; border-top: 1px solid #444; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Transient notice, bottom-right; a 3px left edge carries the status color.
components.css: .ds-toast { max-width: 320px; background: #1a1a1a; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-left: 3px solid #2ba87e; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 14px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55); } .ds-toast-success { border-left-color: #00796b; } .ds-toast-error { border-left-color: #ef5350; }

components.name: Drop Card
components.description: The signature empty state: centered card inviting a drag-and-drop, with a solid surface that survives the always-dark video area.

Or browse for a file to start trimming
components.css: .ds-drop-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; gap: 14px; padding: 28px 32px; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 4px; background: #1a1a1a; max-width: 460px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-drop-icon { display: block; width: 340px; height: auto; } .ds-drop-card h2 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; } .ds-drop-card p { margin: 0; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #777; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #00796b; color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00685c; }

narrative.overview:
ClipSend looks like a tool that is always ready: near-black surfaces, a single calm teal that never shouts, small dense controls sized for speed over spectacle. The app is a workbench for video, not a media player, and it reads that way at a glance. The video itself is the brightest thing in the room; the chrome stays quiet and lets the content work.

The palette is deliberately restrained. One accent hue (teal) does all the signaling: focus rings, active states, readouts, warnings kept to a single amber. Depth comes from tonal steps, not decoration, and shadows appear only on floating layers. Density is tight but never cramped; 12px controls with 8-10px gaps keep a full export workflow inside one screen. In the light theme every surface and text token flips, but the teals are shared because they clear WCAG AA on both backgrounds, and the video letterbox stays dark in both themes (media areas read as content, like a video editor).

The system is Windows-native first: Segoe UI, MDL2 icon glyphs, a frameless custom title bar, tray behavior. Minimal is the point, and the anti-reference is any glossy media-app skin, gradient-heavy chrome, or browser-default widget.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black graphite surfaces with one calm teal accent
Small, dense, uppercase micro-labels; mono readouts for timecode
Flat by default; tonal layering for depth; shadows only on floating layers
Strict 4px radius lock on controls and panels
Windows-native conventions (Segoe UI, MDL2, frameless title bar)
Dark theme default, light variant; video letterbox always dark

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: One accent hue, used everywhere. Two working shades of it: bright Signal Teal for chrome and rings, deep Success Teal for filled surfaces where white text must pass AA. Never introduce a second accent hue.

rules.name: The White-Text Rule
rules.body: White text only on Deep Teal (or the fixed amber badge with dark text). On any other fill, use text-secondary or text-primary depending on the surface.

rules.name: The Letterbox Rule
rules.body: The video stage and timeline canvas stay dark in both themes. Media areas are content, like a video editor, not chrome.

rules.name: The Mono Readout Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for numeric readouts and machine values (timecode, speed, trim points). If it is a number the user must read precisely, it is Consolas; if it is prose, it is Segoe UI.

rules.name: The Micro-Label Rule
rules.body: Small-print uppercase labels (11px minimum, 700, 1-1.2px tracking) mark sections and panels; 11px is the floor for any functional text. Decorative exceptions are limited to badge numerals (10px in a 14px pill) and MDL2 icon glyphs. Never scale labels up into body size; if a label needs to be bigger, it stops being a label.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to float (menus, tooltips, toasts, modals). No shadow on a resting button, card, or panel.

rules.name: The Inset Rule
rules.body: Anything read-only and numeric (timecode strips, trim-info chips, segment indicators) sits in a sunken well (inset-bg on the surface) with a 1px soft border, so the machine's numbers read as embedded in the workbench, not floating on it.

dos: Do use one teal hue for all signaling: Signal Teal for chrome, Deep Teal for filled actions. Stay inside the palette; the canvas colors are the only sanctioned additions and they stay monochrome white-on-graphite.
Do keep the 4px radius on controls and panels, 6px on chips and floating layers, 3px on micro-controls. The shape lock is the system's quiet signature.
Do put white text only on Deep Teal fills (5.3:1 AA) and reserve the bright accent for non-text chrome.
Do set numeric readouts in Consolas and section labels in 10px uppercase with tracking.
Do keep the video letterbox and timeline dark in both themes.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion (collapse slide/settle animations) and prefers-reduced-transparency (drop the backdrop blur) and keep the 2px keyboard focus ring.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue, gradients, glow, or drop shadows on resting surfaces. No neon, no lift, no decorative geometry.
Don't leave browser-default widgets visible: selects get the custom chevron, scrollbars are the thin styled thumbs, checkboxes are custom.
Don't use Mint Readout on light surfaces (it flips to Deep Teal in the light theme) or put the bright accent where white text must sit on it.
Don't scale the micro-labels up or the mono readouts down to prose; the hierarchy is by weight, case, and mono, not by growing type.
